subject.title: tools.exec.approvalRunningNoticeMs is documented but rejected by the 2026.3.24 config schema

question: Should maintainers adopt/rebase https://github.com/BingqingLyu/openclaw/pull/1652, close it and allow a narrow replacement repair, or keep waiting on that fork PR?
rationale: The bug is clear, but an open non-editable conflicting fork PR already claims the exact fix, so automation should not create duplicate work until a maintainer chooses the route.

options.title: Close fork and allow replacement
options.body: Close or supersede the stale conflicting fork PR, then allow a narrow same-repo repair for the schema mismatch.

options.title: Adopt and rebase fork PR
options.body: A maintainer can manually carry the useful schema change forward from the fork branch while dropping stale or conflicting parts.

options.title: Keep waiting
options.body: Leave the issue paired to the fork PR, accepting that the documented config key remains broken on main and the latest release.

recommendation.title: Close fork and allow replacement
recommendation.body: Close or supersede the stale conflicting fork PR, then allow a narrow same-repo repair for the schema mismatch.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced the documented config surface and is the clearest routing owner for choosing the cleanup path.
